record.question: Which of the following statements is false regarding the release of Grants-In-Aid to voluntary organisations?
options: Grants-in-Aid may be sanctioned to ensure minimum staff structure to improve their effectiveness and expand their activities
The grants-in-aid should not exceed 25% of the approved administrative expenses on pay and allowances
Execution of a bond is mandatory for private and government owned institutions
Refund of Grants-in-aid already disbursed may be initiated if the terms and conditions of the bond are not followed
